payload.purpose_context: A test-suite quality review of the regression-marked slice (issues #5618-#5622) found that most regression markers are mislabels on unit or contract tests, several slow end-to-end files pin contracts that cheaper seam tests can hold, one fix (charter scope config loading) has no working guard, and two permission tests fail when the suite runs as root. This mission applies those per-file verdicts so the per-PR suite is faster and every remaining guard provably goes red when its behaviour breaks.
payload.purpose_tldr: Stop mislabelled and slow regression-marked tests from inflating every PR's CI time, and close two real test gaps.

payload.question: Which verdicts govern the change set, and what is out of scope?

payload.final_answer: Apply the per-file ledger verdicts from issues #5618-#5622 (operator brief, non-interactive host): MARKER-ONLY, SPLIT-BY-KIND, SHIFT-LEFT with seam units first, RETIRE only after a planted break re-proves the covering guard, FIX weak oracles; #5620 item 1 is priority; #5622 root-independence. Test-only; product defects found become issues; p0_repro marker work out of scope.
